How 8x8 MIMO Powers Faster 5G

Eight Downlink Streams at Once

8x8 MIMO uses spatial multiplexing to transmit up to eight layers of data to a single user simultaneously when channel conditions allow. Compared with conventional 4x4 MIMO, this doubles downlink capacity and increases the single-user peak rate.

Higher Speeds From Near to Far

Huawei road tests showed that 8x8 MIMO delivered higher downlink speeds throughout the test, with up to 100% improvement at near points and 30% at far points compared with 4x4 MIMO.

SOURCE :
Road test conducted at Huawei Campus, Dongguan, using 1CC, 100MHz and 64T.
Actual performance may vary depending on coverage, location, network conditions and device capabilities.

How AI-Powered Game Turbo Works

WiFi Slicing

Once supported game traffic is identified, the router accelerates it over WiFi to help reduce delays between your device and router.

Dedicated QoS Flow

The router creates a dedicated Quality of Service flow so identified game traffic stays prioritised from end to end.

5G Game Turbo Acceleration

Game Turbo prioritises gaming traffic by allocating dedicated 5G uplink time slots for your device to communicate with the network, eliminating the need to wait for available transmission schedules. This reduces latency between your 5G router and the network for a smoother, more responsive gaming experience.

Activation Note :
When Game Turbo activates, the router’s orange gaming light turns on so U know gaming acceleration is active.

Over 60% Lower Latency Under Load

In a U Mobile internal network test, Game Turbo reduced latency from 49.42ms to 19.60ms under scheduling load. Under normal load, latency also improved from 15.15ms to 13.26ms.

Source :
U Mobile internal network test, May 2026, using 100MHz TDD 3.5GHz spectrum. Actual performance may vary depending on network conditions, location, device and supported game.

    ULTRA Home 5G Pro is a home internet service powered by U Mobile's ULTRA5G network. It offers fast and reliable wireless broadband for your home without requiring fibre installation.

     

    2. How is ULTRA Home 5G Pro different from ULTRA Home 5G?

    4. Where is ULTRA Home 5G Pro available?

    5. Does Game Turbo make my internet faster?


    Game Turbo is designed to improve gaming performance, not increase overall internet speed.


    6. Can Game Turbo help reduce gaming ping?


    Yes, it may help improve responsiveness and reduce latency for supported games. Actual performance depends on network and game server conditions.


    7. Does it work over Wi-Fi and Ethernet?


    Yes. Game Turbo works on both Wi-Fi and Ethernet connections. However, for the best gaming experience, we recommend using an Ethernet connection whenever possible.


    8. Can I enjoy Game Turbo on all U Mobile routers?


    No. Game Turbo is only available on supported ULTRA Home 5G Pro router model.


    9. How does Game Turbo identify supported games?


    The router automatically detects supported gaming traffic and applies optimisation accordingly and router led indicator changed to Orange colour


    10. Does Game Turbo guarantee smooth gaming?


    No. Gaming performance still depends on network coverage, signal strength, device performance and game server conditions.

8x8 MIMO

    1. What is 8×8 MIMO?


    8×8 MIMO is an advanced antenna technology that helps the router handle more data efficiently and improve wireless performance.


    2. Does 8×8 MIMO mean 8 times faster speed?


    No. It can improve performance, but it does not guarantee speeds that are 8 times faster.


    3. Will 8×8 MIMO work everywhere?


    No. Availability depends on network support and signal conditions at your location.


    4. Why does my device sometimes show lower MIMO levels?


    The router automatically adjusts based on signal quality, network conditions and device capability.


    5. Do all my devices need to support 8×8 MIMO?


    No. Devices with different Wi-Fi standards can still connect normally.


    6. Will 8×8 MIMO improve Wi-Fi coverage?


    It is designed primarily to improve capacity and performance, not to guarantee wider coverage.


    7. Can 8×8 MIMO and Game Turbo work together?


    Yes. Both features can work together to improve your overall online experience.


    8. Do I need to activate 8×8 MIMO?


    No. The router automatically uses the best supported configuration.

The Plan
  1. Is ULTRA Home 5G a 5G – ready plan?

    Yes, it is. ULTRA Home 5G subscribers with compatible 5G devices (Router, Modem or Mobile phones) can experience the full potential of our 5G network subject to availability.


  2. What is the ULTRA Home 5G Plan?

    It is our new ultra-fast 5G & 4G broadband subscription service with unlimited data.


  3. What speeds can I expect from ULTRA Home 5G? 

    ULTRA Home 5G offers uncapped speeds. You can expect to get the fastest possible speeds when you are connected to our network.

    Digital Nasional Berhad (DNB) guarantees a minimum download speed of 100Mbps across Malaysia’s 5G network. This means that you should be able to achieve at least 100Mbps download speeds within 5G coverage areas.


  4. Can I share the data through Hotspot and what is the quota allocation for Hotspot?

    Yes, you can share the ULTRA Home 5G data through Hotspot with no device restrictions.


  5. Does ULTRA Home 5G come with a router and/or modem?

    No, ULTRA Home 5G is a SIM only plan.


  6. Can I view my data usage?

    Users can refer to the U Mobile AppU Mobile App to see their data usage. However, there are no concerns on data usage as our broadband plan provides Unlimited Data usage.


  7. Is there any deposit fee or upfront payment required upon registration?

    Foreigners are required to place RM500 and upfront payment as a deposit upon registration. Malaysian citizens and permanent residents are only required to pay an advance upfront payment equivalent to one month’s charges.


  8. Do I get back my RM500 deposit if I terminate the service?

    Upon your request to terminate our service, the deposit will be refunded back to you after 60 working days.  Do note that we will offset your deposit with your last billed amount and any other relevant charges.


  9. Can I change my current Postpaid or Wireless Broadband (WBB) plan to ULTRA Home 5G?

    You are not allowed to convert your current Postpaid plan to ULTRA Home 5G and would have to register for a new ULTRA Home 5G plan. However, wireless broadband plans (WB48, WB68, WBB88,WB128) can be converted to ULTRA Home 5G. Terms and conditions apply.


  10. Where can I subscribe or get more inquiries regarding ULTRA Home 5G?

    • Visit any of our U mobile stores nationwide
    • Call our Customer Service team at 018- 388 1318.

       
  11. What devices are compatible with ULTRA Home 5G?

    ULTRA Home 5G can be used with a variety of 5G and / or 4G LTE devices. You can also use it in your smart devices such as phones, tablets, smart cameras and GPS trackers. U Mobile bears no responsibility should customers purchase a device that is not compatible with Malaysia’s 5G and 4G networks.

    Please refer to our website at www.u.com.my/Home5G for examples of reliable devices.


  12. Does my ULTRA Home 5G plan comes with SMS and Voice/Video call?

    No, ULTRA Home 5G is purely for data usage only.


  13. Can I use the unlimited data from my ULTRA Home 5G plan overseas?

    No, the plan is for domestic usage only (within Malaysia).


  14. Is there any contract tied with the subscription?

    There is no contract tied to this plan. You may cancel anytime without any penalties.


  15. Is there any speed cap for ULTRA Home 5G?

    ULTRA Home 5G comes with uncapped speeds. Note that we will manage your surfing speeds if any abuse or unusually high usage occurs.


  16. Is P2P allowed on ULTRA Home 5G?

    P2P and torrenting is not allowed on ULTRA Home 5G.


  17. Are there any speed restrictions with ULTRA Home 5G?

    We may restrict your speeds if we detect abuse or unusually high usage above 1,000GB.
Registration
  1. Where can I subscribe to ULTRA Home 5G?

    You can purchase the plan at any of the options below:

    • U Mobile Online Store: https://shop.u.com.my/
    • Visit any of our U Mobile stores nationwide.

       
  2. Who is eligible to register for ULTRA Home 5G?

    • Anyone living in Malaysia above 18 years old.
    • The plan is available for new registration.
    • Existing Ultra Unlimited Wireless Broadband subscribers are entitled to Change Rate Plan (CRP) (WBB48, WBB68, WBB88, WBB128) to ULTRA Home 5G.

       
  3. How can I check which areas are covered for ULTRA Home 5G?

    Check for your coverage here.


  4. What are the relevant documents required to register for ULTRA Home 5G?

    • NRIC for Malaysians and permanent residents.
    • Passport for Non-Malaysian citizens / foreigners.

       
  5. What do I get upon successful registration of ULTRA Home 5G?

    You will get a U Mobile SIM card only. Upon receipt of SIM card, pair it with 5G Wi-Fi routers to experience the full potential of 5G broadband speeds.


  6. Are there any payments I need to pay during registration?

    Yes, there are, such as the following:

    • Upfront payment applies to all ULTRA Home 5G subscribers.
    • Refundable deposit fee (RM500) applies to non-Malaysian citizen.
    • U Mobile may from time to time revise the payment at our absolute discretion.

       
  7. What is an Upfront Payment?

    • It’s an advance payment that is equivalent to the monthly commitment you would make when you sign up and register a Broadband plan.
    • For example, the upfront payment for ULTRA Home 5G will be RM68.
    • This payment will be collected once you sign up for your chosen plan.
    • The upfront payment will used to offset your next month’s bill and if there is any outstanding balance, the customer will required to pay the balance.
Installation
  1. Would U Mobile help me install ULTRA Home 5G into my personal device?

    No technical installation is required. ULTRA Home 5G is designed to be a plug and play service. You simply insert the SIM into the device of your choice on your own.

    Note that subscriptions via U Mobile eShop requires activation by keying in the last 4 digits of your SIM serial number into your eShop account.

How 8x8 MIMO Powers Faster 5G
Eight Downlink Streams at Once
8x8 MIMO uses spatial multiplexing to transmit up to eight layers of data to a single user simultaneously when channel conditions allow. Compared with conventional 4x4 MIMO, this doubles downlink capacity and increases the single-user peak rate.
Higher Speeds From Near to Far
Huawei road tests showed that 8x8 MIMO delivered higher downlink speeds throughout the test, with up to 100% improvement at near points and 30% at far points compared with 4x4 MIMO.
SOURCE :
Road test conducted at Huawei Campus, Dongguan, using 1CC, 100MHz and 64T.
Actual performance may vary depending on coverage, location, network conditions and device capabilities.

How AI-Powered Game Turbo Works
Three Layers of Gaming Acceleration
Lower Latency
WiFi Slicing
Once supported game traffic is identified, the router accelerates it over WiFi to help reduce delays between your device and router.
Dedicated QoS Flow
The router creates a dedicated Quality of Service flow so identified game traffic stays prioritised from end to end.
5G Game Turbo Acceleration
Game Turbo prioritises gaming traffic by allocating dedicated 5G uplink time slots for your device to communicate with the network, eliminating the need to wait for available transmission schedules. This reduces latency between your 5G router and the network for a smoother, more responsive gaming experience.
Activation Note :
When Game Turbo activates, the router’s orange gaming light turns on so U know gaming acceleration is active.
Over 60% Lower Latency Under Load
In a U Mobile internal network test, Game Turbo reduced latency from 49.42ms to 19.60ms under scheduling load. Under normal load, latency also improved from 15.15ms to 13.26ms.
Source :
U Mobile internal network test, May 2026, using 100MHz TDD 3.5GHz spectrum. Actual performance may vary depending on network conditions, location, device and supported game.

5. Does Game Turbo make my internet faster?
Game Turbo is designed to improve gaming performance, not increase overall internet speed.
6. Can Game Turbo help reduce gaming ping?
Yes, it may help improve responsiveness and reduce latency for supported games. Actual performance depends on network and game server conditions.
7. Does it work over Wi-Fi and Ethernet?
Yes. Game Turbo works on both Wi-Fi and Ethernet connections. However, for the best gaming experience, we recommend using an Ethernet connection whenever possible.
8. Can I enjoy Game Turbo on all U Mobile routers?
No. Game Turbo is only available on supported ULTRA Home 5G Pro router model.
9. How does Game Turbo identify supported games?
The router automatically detects supported gaming traffic and applies optimisation accordingly and router led indicator changed to Orange colour
10. Does Game Turbo guarantee smooth gaming?
No. Gaming performance still depends on network coverage, signal strength, device performance and game server conditions.
8x8 MIMO
1. What is 8×8 MIMO?
8×8 MIMO is an advanced antenna technology that helps the router handle more data efficiently and improve wireless performance.
2. Does 8×8 MIMO mean 8 times faster speed?
No. It can improve performance, but it does not guarantee speeds that are 8 times faster.
3. Will 8×8 MIMO work everywhere?
No. Availability depends on network support and signal conditions at your location.
4. Why does my device sometimes show lower MIMO levels?
The router automatically adjusts based on signal quality, network conditions and device capability.
5. Do all my devices need to support 8×8 MIMO?
No. Devices with different Wi-Fi standards can still connect normally.
6. Will 8×8 MIMO improve Wi-Fi coverage?
It is designed primarily to improve capacity and performance, not to guarantee wider coverage.
7. Can 8×8 MIMO and Game Turbo work together?
Yes. Both features can work together to improve your overall online experience.
8. Do I need to activate 8×8 MIMO?
No. The router automatically uses the best supported configuration.

sooka is a Malaysian streaming service that offers a variety of free and premium content. It includes live sports and TV channels as well as on-demand content such as TV series, movies and more.
sooka can be enjoyed on a variety of devices, including smartphones, tablets, computers, and smart TVs.
